result_text:
The contributor lists are no longer cut off at `contributorsListLimit`. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or a landscape report.

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`:** I removed the `.limit(limit)` call, so the tables list every contributor. These tables cover all contributors, recent contributors, bots and teams. I also removed the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. Ordering is unchanged.
- **`ContributorListsSection.java`:** the bar chart of recent commits per contributor now draws one bar per recently active contributor.

I left the `contributorsListLimit` setting in `LandscapeConfiguration`, but nothing reads it for these lists now.
